content.value: A prestressed concrete rectangular beam 500 mm by 800 mm has a simple span of (28) 7.50 m and is loaded by a uniform load of 50 KN/m including its own weight. The prestressing tendon is located as shown and produces an effective prestress of 1620 KN. Compute the fiber stresses in the concrete at A and B.
